items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: I had played with them... that's how I knew them fellas like Reddy Keppel

ctx.x: Well, I had played with them but I mean I was in a regular band like I told you. When I was a kid there, that's how I knew them fellas like Reddy Keppel and Bunk and them. Well, I know them fellas that when I was a little boy, you see. Well, those fellas go around and they be playing those dances like that. They'd all say, let that little kid play something. I didn't play a number like that. People would, they'd hear the drum playing but they couldn't, they'd bark and they're already high and they couldn't see me…

Well, I think that covers most of your life pretty well. We don't want to keep you here all afternoon. I know you've been talking a long time so I think there's just about two here. Unless there's something else you want to add that you can think of about your life and music?
